request.summary: Create a rotating call-center unit dashboard from an existing keyed KPI datasource.
request.audience: Call-center supervisors monitoring unit-level workload and service health on shared displays.
request.primaryGoal: Make one business unit and its most important live KPIs readable at a glance before rotating alphabetically.

assumptions: All BGE, TOTAL, and Other are aggregate records excluded by default while DSTATS remains a valid unit.
Inactive units remain visible by default because staffing and activity expectations require customer confirmation.
The source is a live snapshot, so the widget does not imply historical trends.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: The supplied operational references are landscape supervisor boards, so the design prioritizes full-screen and wide-low control-room placements.

settings.purpose: Message shown when no valid units remain.
Comma-separated aggregate unit names omitted from rotation.
Optionally excludes units with no staffing or call activity.
Selects the coordinated Light, Dark, or Custom color scheme.

states.expectation: The coordinated dark preset preserves operational KPI hierarchy and semantic tones.
Configured aggregate labels are absent while real units remain alphabetically ordered.
Inactive units remain stable and legible when filtering is disabled.
An explicit empty state replaces missing unit records.
Malformed records are skipped without breaking valid units.
A long business-unit name remains contained on a wide-low surface.
The next alphabetically sorted unit replaces the current unit on schedule.
Updated call metrics appear without rebuilding the app.

behaviors.expectation: Wrapped keyed objects, direct objects, and arrays normalize to the same unit model.
Valid units advance alphabetically after the configured duration.
Datasource refreshes replace visible KPI values in place.

visualDirection.summary: A light industrial supervisor console derived from the supplied call-center KPI dashboard reference, with instrument gauges and compact operational readouts.
references: User-provided light Call Center KPI Dashboard reference with dial gauges and grouped operational statistics.
signatureChoices: Three instrument-like gauges form a continuous monitoring cluster.
A light control-room palette and ruled metric field replace dark floating dashboard cards.
avoid: Dark teal cards with a decorative top accent rail.

visualReview.intent: A precise supervisor dashboard with one dominant unit identity, three bounded gauges, and an evenly filled metric field.
focus: Verify wide-low layouts preserve readable gauge geometry and never push the final KPI beyond the right edge.
Verify inactive and zero-value units still fill the assigned area without visually collapsing.
Verify unit names and the main title preserve descenders without clipping.
